heading: Work Experience
paragraphs: I’m currently working as a Technical Associate at NAB, where I’m supporting the rollout of a new platform and continuing to grow as a Java and Spring Boot developer.

Before NAB, I worked as a Graduate SAP Technical Consultant at Discovery Consulting, focusing on SAP BTP Extension Development and building solutions with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model. I also have a background in full-stack development, using Java, Python, and JavaScript, with frontend experience in HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, and React-Redux, and backend experience using the MVC pattern with the CodeIgniter framework.

Lately, I’ve been spending my own time exploring cloud engineering and agentic AI — AI systems that can plan and take actions, not just answer questions — which is the direction I want to build my career toward.
